## What changed

Describe the behavior and the owner or boundary that changed.

## Verification

List commands, mission URLs, and screenshots or GIFs for intentional UI changes.

## Structural refactor (when applicable)

- Link the plan written before the split.
- Give the original file's physical line count and all resulting files' counts.
- Show that the largest resulting piece is at most 70% of the original.
- Explain the new responsibility, state and effect boundaries; note any
  compatibility wrappers and remaining debt.
- Update the source-size baseline and completed-refactor record when an
  existing oversized cap is lowered or removed.
